name: Elder White Dragon

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Action Recovery
traits.details: Whenever the dragon ends its turn, any dazing, stunning, dominating effect on it ends.

traits.name: Instinctive Rampage
traits.details: On an initiative of 10 + the dragon’s initiative check, the dragon can move up to its speed as a free action. The dragon can move through enemies’ spaces and gains resist 5 to all damage during the move. Each time the dragon enters an enemy’s space for the first time during the move, it can use claw against that enemy. If the attack hits, the target also falls prone. If the dragon cannot use a free action to take this move due to a dominating or stunning effect, then that effect ends instead of the dragon making this move.

traits.name: Savage Blood
traits.details: While the dragon is bloodied, it can score a critical hit on a roll of 17-20.

powers.name: Icy Tomb
powers.description: The target is slowed and takes ongoing 20 cold damage (save ends both).

hit.description: The target is stunned, cannot be pulled, pushed, or slid, and takes ongoing 45 cold damage (save ends all).

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target is slowed and takes ongoing 20 cold damage (save ends both).

hit.description: cold damage, and the target is slowed (save ends).

powers.name: Tail Slap
powers.trigger: An enemy hits the dragon while flanking it.

hit.description: damage, and the dragon pushes the target up to 5 squares.

effect.description: Breath weapon recharges, and the dragon uses it.
